SELECT u.agent, MAX(u.agent_name) as agentName, COALESCE(SUM(c.amount), 0) as czRealAmount, COALESCE(SUM(c.amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(w.inputamount), 0) as lr, MAX(u.salesman_name) as salesmanName, u.salesmanid, COALESCE(SUM(w.inputamount), 0) as txRealAmount FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_charge_order c ON u.id = c.user_id AND c.state = 1
AND c.create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.startTime} / 1000)
AND c.create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.endTime} / 1000)
LEFT JOIN tb_withdraw_order w ON u.id = w.user_id AND w.state IN (1, 2)
AND w.create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.startTime} / 1000)
AND w.create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.endTime} / 1000)
WHERE 1=1
AND u.agent = #{params.agent}
AND u.salesmanid = #{params.salesmanid}
GROUP BY u.agent, u.salesmanid
ORDER BY ${params.orderField} ${params.order}
ORDER BY u.agent, u.salesmanid
